comment: The third wave's BNpcBase 1704 (BNpcName 1451, layouts 4290117-4290137, nine of them seen): level 50, 129 HP, one every 8 s for a minute, each after the player: it stands 4.9 s, walks up (about 1.9 yalms a second on retail; at an NPC's usual pace here) and uses 1341 on reaching them (instant; 448, 672, 672 and 897 to the player in four uses), dying with it (the director, content/questbattle/76.lua.) No auto-attack. Heart of the Forest (quest 1084, quest battle 76, drop-in layer QB_JobWhm500_001 of fst_f1). From Bob's Chronofoil capture 667a68c5 (2026-11-16, three runs: two lost, one won, `questkit chronofoil --battle 0.20`, `0.22`, `0.24`, territory 320, duty 369; a level 50 White Mage): `players` is the median damage to the player, `npcs` to the other side's NPCs (or a heal's on them), times from its pull. Hitbox not recorded.
